question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: When

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• Before means earlier than the time that.
 
• Until means up to the time or the event mentioned.
 
• When is used for talking about the time at which something happens or happened.
 
• While means at the same time as.​
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "The blubber is removed after the whale is slaughtered."
 
• As per the meaning of the given words it is clear that "when" should be used.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete passage: *There are three main groups of oils: animal, vegetable, and mineral. Great quantities of animal oil come (1) from __whales, those enormous creatures of the sea (2) __which __are the largest remaining animals in the world. (3) __To protect __the whale from the cold of the Arctic seas, nature __(4) has provided__ it with a thick covering of fat called blubber.** (5) **__**When** __the whale is killed; the blubber is stripped (6) ________and boiled down. It produces a great (7) _______of oil which can be made into food for human _______ (8) _______.A few other creatures yield oil, but none so (9) _______as the whale. The livers of the cod and the halibut, two (10) ________ of fish, yield nourishing oil.*
